note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative. The comparison shows two kinds of side note; it does not rank them or state any legal effect.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: A: a copy of the words of ¶2 slides out from beneath the page and is pinned beside it. B: R. Ferrer’s card slides out of the commentaries shelf and is pinned beside the same ¶2. Both tied by a thread, kept apart by the gutter.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: a four-paragraph fictional filing rule, the side note tied to ¶4 (lower on the page, so both side notes travel further down), a different commentator and wording of the scenarios.

passages: Documents are filed with the registry office.
Each document carries a filing number.
The registry records the day of filing.
A filed document may be inspected by the parties.
sources.commentaryText: Takes “the parties” here to include their representatives.

scenarioA.label: Quoted rule
scenarioA.caption: The side note repeats ¶4 word for word

scenarioB.label: Commentator’s reading
scenarioB.caption: The side note gives M. Okoye’s reading of ¶4

params.changedFact: Only one fact differs: whose words the side note beside ¶4 carries

comparisonLabels.neutral: Both notes stay outside the rule text — no reading is endorsed

presets.name: long-labels-stress
presets.description: Long scenario labels and captions, long changed fact, shared facts and neutral note, long source and commentary text.

sources.sourceTitle: Article 7 — Notices, communications and addresses of the parties
passages: Each party names in writing a postal address and an electronic address for notices.
Notice is given in writing, is signed by the sender and states the date on which it is sent.
The sender keeps a copy of every notice together with any proof of dispatch.
sources.commentaryWork: Annotated Notes on the Example Code of Obligations
sources.commentaryText: Reads the words “in writing” in this passage as also covering email messages that identify the sender.

scenarioA.label: Primary source text quoted verbatim
scenarioA.caption: The side note repeats the exact words of paragraph 2 as printed in the source

scenarioB.label: Commentator’s attributed interpretation
scenarioB.caption: The side note carries Dr. Ferrer-Villanueva’s reading of paragraph 2, signed and dated

params.changedFact: Only one fact differs between the two boards: what the side note next to paragraph 2 carries
sharedFacts: Same primary source page and edition
Same reading board, gutter and thread

comparisonLabels.guide: Changed fact: the content of the side note beside paragraph 2
comparisonLabels.neutral: Two side notes shown side by side, both kept outside the source text — neither is ranked, preferred or treated as law

presets.name: baseline-es
presets.description: Baseline in Spanish (built-in labels and fictional content).

passages: Cada parte indica una dirección para avisos.
El aviso se da por escrito e indica la fecha de envío.
Quien envía el aviso conserva una copia.
sources.commentaryText: Entiende que «por escrito» incluye aquí el correo electrónico.

scenarioA.label: Texto fuente
scenarioA.caption: La nota lateral copia las palabras del ¶2

scenarioB.label: Interpretación del comentarista
scenarioB.caption: La nota lateral recoge la lectura de R. Ferrer sobre el ¶2

params.changedFact: Solo cambia un hecho: qué lleva la nota lateral junto al ¶2

comparisonLabels.guide: Hecho cambiado: el contenido de la nota
comparisonLabels.neutral: Dos notas laterales, ambas junto al texto — ninguna se clasifica ni se prefiere
